project_type: Pure PHP web application - internal CRM tool for Bharat SEO agency
build_system: None - vanilla PHP, no composer, no framework. Direct file serving via Apache/Nginx.
test_framework: PHP lint validation (php -l) - no external test framework available
verification_instructions: 1. Run php -l on all PHP files to ensure no syntax errors. 2. Verify all required files exist per the folder structure spec. 3. Verify database.sql is valid SQL syntax.
setup_instructions: 1. Upload files to web server. 2. Import database.sql into MySQL. 3. Configure config.php with DB credentials and API keys. 4. Set document root to project folder. 5. Login with admin/admin123.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no external package installs, no composer, no npm. All code must be vanilla PHP with native extensions only. No MySQL server running - code written for MySQL but tested via syntax validation only. PHP 8.4 with curl, PDO, pdo_mysql, json, session, openssl, mbstring, dom, SimpleXML available.
key_patterns: PHP PDO for database, PHP sessions for auth, cURL for HTTP requests, prepared statements for security, password_hash/password_verify for credentials, CSRF tokens for forms, htmlspecialchars for output escaping.
directory_structure: Root: config.php, functions.php, database.sql. admin/: all admin pages + includes/ subfolder. cron/: cron job scripts. assets/css/ and assets/js/ for static resources.
